title: MNS Suporte
heading: Current state
text:
Current state
This repository was initialized on 2026-11-25 from Orion commit `6fe8aa850d9fc3d8e78584c6f4af27d524e3ac75`. It contains the foundation's architecture, policies, accepted ADRs, tooling, validation gate, CI, generated references, and internal [Living Documentation Portal](apps/web/README.md#living-documentation-portal), and the neutral web shell. The API verifies official Meta WhatsApp webhooks, persists inbound messages and dispatches queued replies with delivery tracking. The GLPI adapter supports exact active-user lookup and a guarded single ticket-creation attempt. The product plan tracks conversation processing and the live pilot. The complete portal remains available in local development; production builds exclude it and its generated assets by default. Product help and public API documentation require separately approved sources and application-owned presentation under [the documentation policy](docs/architecture/living-documentation.md#documentation-audiences-and-publication). The employee identity service verifies corporate mailbox control through short-lived codes. The product plan tracks its conversation wiring.
The [project plan](docs/project/implementation-plan.md) and [project human actions](docs/project/human-actions.md) own this repository's current work and external prerequisites. The [project manifest](.orion/project.json) records the project identity, the immutable initialization commit, and the Orion baseline currently integrated. [Project derivation](docs/project-derivation.md) explains how to inspect provenance and adopt newer Orion revisions through reviewed merges.
